newsitem.title: USA: Northland Cranberries sees FY97 Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: Northland Cranberries sees FY97 Q4 loss.

text.p: Northland Cranberries Inc said Tuesday it expected to report a loss in its fiscal 1997 fourth quarter ending in August, citing promotional activites for its branded juice.
The company said it expects to report a profit for the fiscal year.
The company reported a loss of $669,000, or $0.05 a share in the year ago quarter and a profit of $6.9 million, or $0.50 a share for all of fiscal 1996.
Earlier Tuesday, Northland Cranberries reported a third quarter profit of $225,000, or $0.02 a share, compared with a profit of $855,000, or $0.06 a share a year ago.

"The sudden and unexpected termination of a planned acquisition, as announced earlier, resulted in our inability to convert a significant amount of inventory of raw frozen fruit into revenues during the reporting period," chief executive John Swendrowski said in a news release. "That inventory currently remains in our freezer and will contribute toward future revenues as it is utilized in the production of our branded juice, cranberry juice concentrate and other value-added products."
Northland shares closed up 1-1/8 at 15-7/8 Tuesday.
